get.summary: Gets a list of organizations as cached from Keycloak.
get.description: Returns the cached Keycloak organizations, each including its role bundle (changemaker, data provider, and/or funder) and its current cached members. The caller's JWT must carry the PDC-service `pdc-admin` realm role or at least one of the Keycloak `realm-management` organization-visibility roles (`view-organizations`, `manage-organizations`, or `manage-realm`).
